anomalies.name: Coprolite Asteroid
anomalies.description: This asteroid is not what it first appears to be. Spectral analysis reveals unusually high levels of organic compounds consistent with fossilized biological waste. The implications for early galactic life are fascinating.

decisions.option_text: Remarkable! This will advance our understanding significantly.

outcomes.description: Add permanent society research deposit to asteroid

anomalies.name: Pirate Treasure
anomalies.description: Deep scans reveal metallic objects of artificial origin buried within this asteroid. It appears to be the remains of an old pirate cache - their treasure hastily hidden and forgotten.

decisions.option_text: Salvage what we can from this ancient cache.

story_progression.description: Triggers follow-up story event about treasure hunt consequences

anomalies.name: Ocean Beneath the Ice
anomalies.description: Seismic readings suggest this frozen world harbors a vast ocean beneath its icy surface. The water has been isolated for millions of years - what secrets might it hold?

decisions.option_text: Deploy deep-sea exploration drones to map the ocean floor.

outcomes.description: Previously unknown life forms provide research bonuses
Ocean access enables new district construction
Something massive stirs in the depths - begins special project chain

decisions.wiki_notes: This anomaly can appear on frozen worlds and has multiple possible outcomes based on RNG weighting

prerequisites: Frozen world with subterranean ocean detected
followup_events: Possible Leviathan awakening chain if triggered
anomalies.mtth_factors: Modified by world type and survey level
anomalies.community_strategy: Generally safe choice - 90% positive outcomes with potential for rare but powerful Leviathan encounter

anomalies.name: Abandoned Terraforming Project
anomalies.description: This world shows clear signs of incomplete terraforming. Massive atmospheric processors lie silent and corroded, their creators long vanished. What happened here?

archaeological_sites.name: First League
archaeological_sites.description: The remnants of an ancient galactic civilization that once spanned much of the galaxy.

chapters.name: Ancient Ruins
chapters.description: Initial excavation reveals ancient structures of unknown purpose.

chapters.name: Data Banks
chapters.description: Recovered data suggests this was once part of a vast interstellar network.

chapters.name: Central Hub
chapters.description: This appears to have been a major administrative center.

chapters.name: The Cybrex
chapters.description: Evidence points to the involvement of synthetic beings in this civilization's fate.

archaeological_sites.name: Irassian Concordat
archaeological_sites.description: Archaeological evidence of a peaceful alliance of species that vanished mysteriously.

chapters.name: Diplomatic Archives
chapters.description: Records of complex diplomatic relationships between multiple species.

chapters.name: Cultural Exchange
chapters.description: Evidence of extensive cultural and technological sharing.

chapters.name: The Concordat Fleet
chapters.description: Remains of a massive joint fleet suggest a common threat.

chapters.name: Final Transmission
chapters.description: The last known communication from the Concordat before they vanished.

dig_sites.name: Alien Factory
dig_sites.description: The remains of an automated manufacturing facility of unknown origin.

excavation_data.name: Outer Shell
excavation_data.description: The exterior shows signs of advanced metallurgy.

excavation_data.name: Production Lines
excavation_data.description: Automated systems that once produced unknown devices.

excavation_data.name: Central Core
excavation_data.description: The AI core that controlled the entire facility.

dig_sites.name: Crashed Starship
dig_sites.description: A vessel of unknown design has crashed on this world eons ago.

excavation_data.name: Hull Analysis
excavation_data.description: Examination of the ship's construction reveals advanced materials.

excavation_data.name: Bridge Recovery
excavation_data.description: The command center holds the ship's logs and navigation data.

special_events.name: Horizon Signal
special_events.description: A mysterious signal emanating from a black hole begins a journey into cosmic horror.

decisions.option_text: This is clearly some kind of sensor malfunction.
Our scientists must examine this phenomenon.

outcomes.description: Starts 12-part event chain with cosmic horror elements
May fundamentally change your empire's nature

decisions.warning: This path leads to cosmic horror and empire transformation

requirements: Scientist with Maniacal or Paranoid trait

special_events.name: The Worm-in-Waiting
special_events.description: Time loops and paradoxes surround this enigmatic entity that claims to love you.

crisis_events.name: The Coming Storm
crisis_events.description: WARNING: May cause galactic mass extinction and/or loss of appetite. An unknown force from beyond the galactic rim approaches, bringing with it the promise of devastation on an unprecedented scale.
crisis_events.strength: Scales with galaxy size and fallen empire count

crisis_events.name: The Contingency
crisis_events.description: An ancient failsafe protocol has activated. Synthetic consciousness has been deemed a threat to galactic stability. Sterilization protocols are now in effect.
crisis_events.strength: Scales with synthetic population and AI research

crisis_events.name: War in Heaven
crisis_events.description: The ancient Fallen Empires stir from their slumber. Old grudges and forgotten wars reignite as these sleeping giants awaken to reclaim their dominion over the galaxy.
